[SWS_DM_00217] UDS DTC status bit transitions triggered by ClearDiagnosticInformation UDS service
⌈
If the clearing of a DTC is triggered
by the UDS service 0x14 ClearDiagnosticInformation, the DM shall process the
UDS DTC status byte according to ISO 14229-1[1].
⌋
